assertions.description: CSS.supports accepts alpha(from red / 0.5), the numeric alpha-value form of the at-risk alpha() grammar.
CSS.supports accepts alpha(from red / 50%), the percentage alpha-value form.
With the slash/alpha omitted, alpha(from rgb(255 0 0 / 0.3)) retains the origin's 0.3 alpha under the current draft/WPT contract.
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof CSS === 'undefined' || !CSS.supports('color', 'alpha(from rgb(255 0 0 / 0.3))')) return false; const d = document.createElement('div'); d.style.backgroundColor = 'alpha(from rgb(255 0 0 / 0.3))'; document.body.appendChild(d); const c = getComputedStyle(d).backgroundColor; d.remove(); return /rgba\(\s*255\s*,\s*0\s*,\s*0\s*,\s*0\.3\s*\)/.test(c) || /color\(srgb\s+1(?:\.0+)?\s+0(?:\.0+)?\s+0(?:\.0+)?\s+\/\s+0\.3\s*\)/.test(c); })()

assertions.description: alpha(from red / none) computes with a missing alpha component under the current draft/WPT expectation; this serialization area still has open CSSWG/WPT issues.
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof CSS === 'undefined' || !CSS.supports('color', 'alpha(from red / none)')) return false; const d = document.createElement('div'); d.style.backgroundColor = 'alpha(from red / none)'; document.body.appendChild(d); const c = getComputedStyle(d).backgroundColor; d.remove(); return /color\(srgb\s+1(?:\.0+)?\s+0(?:\.0+)?\s+0(?:\.0+)?\s+\/\s+none\s*\)/.test(c); })()

assertions.description: CSS.supports accepts calc(alpha * 0.5), where alpha references the origin color's alpha component.
alpha(from #ff0000 / 50%) computes with red channels unchanged and alpha 0.5. The check accepts current legacy or modern sRGB serialization because notation is not the color-semantic contract.
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof CSS === 'undefined' || !CSS.supports('color', 'alpha(from #ff0000 / 50%)')) return false; const d = document.createElement('div'); d.style.backgroundColor = 'alpha(from #ff0000 / 50%)'; document.body.appendChild(d); const c = getComputedStyle(d).backgroundColor; d.remove(); return /rgba\(\s*255\s*,\s*0\s*,\s*0\s*,\s*0\.5\s*\)/.test(c) || /color\(srgb\s+1(?:\.0+)?\s+0(?:\.0+)?\s+0(?:\.0+)?\s+\/\s+0\.5\s*\)/.test(c); })()

assertions.description: alpha(from rgb(255 0 0 / 0.8) / calc(alpha * 0.5)) computes alpha 0.4 while retaining the red components.
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof CSS === 'undefined' || !CSS.supports('color', 'alpha(from rgb(255 0 0 / 0.8) / calc(alpha * 0.5))')) return false; const d = document.createElement('div'); d.style.backgroundColor = 'alpha(from rgb(255 0 0 / 0.8) / calc(alpha * 0.5))'; document.body.appendChild(d); const c = getComputedStyle(d).backgroundColor; d.remove(); return /rgba\(\s*255\s*,\s*0\s*,\s*0\s*,\s*0\.4\s*\)/.test(c) || /color\(srgb\s+1(?:\.0+)?\s+0(?:\.0+)?\s+0(?:\.0+)?\s+\/\s+0\.4\s*\)/.test(c); })()

assertions.description: A display-p3 origin computes as color(display-p3 1 0 0 / 0.5), directly checking the draft's origin-space-preservation contract. This serialization check does not claim a particular monitor can display the gamut.
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof CSS === 'undefined' || !CSS.supports('color', 'alpha(from color(display-p3 1 0 0) / 0.5)')) return false; const d = document.createElement('div'); d.style.backgroundColor = 'alpha(from color(display-p3 1 0 0) / 0.5)'; document.body.appendChild(d); const c = getComputedStyle(d).backgroundColor; d.remove(); return /color\(display-p3\s+1(?:\.0+)?\s+0(?:\.0+)?\s+0(?:\.0+)?\s+\/\s+0\.5\s*\)/.test(c); })()
